summary.title: Making a Reddit + Facebook Messenger Bot
summary.one_liner: You learn how to build a Facebook Messenger bot with Flask that serves fresh Reddit memes, motivational posts, jokes and shower thoughts, deployed on Heroku with a Postgres database that avoids repeat posts.
keywords: how to make a chatbot with python
takeaways: Create a Reddit app to get client_id and client_secret, then fetch subreddit posts with PRAW.
Build a Flask app that handles Facebook webhook verification and incoming messages, then replies via the Graph API.
Deploy the app to Heroku with a Procfile and requirements.txt, and add a hobby Postgres database.
Track sent posts with a many-to-many users/posts relation so each user does not receive repeats.
summary.summary: The author describes building a Facebook Messenger bot that returns memes, motivational posts, jokes and shower thoughts sourced from Reddit. The stack is Flask for the backend, Heroku for free hosting and Reddit as the data source, accessed with the praw library. The post walks through creating the Reddit and Facebook apps, deploying a basic webhook to Heroku, and integrating Reddit fetching. It also adds a Postgres many-to-many table to record which posts each user has already received, plus quick replies and a fallback image. The code is Python 2 (print statements) and dates from 2017.
